title: Just found this, and help me understand if I'm in the same place
content: I often have to cross a creek, lots of people are going to a festival. camping, stage. etc. there's also a outdoor market/ boardwalk area. has restaurants and clubs. I go here almost nightly. the re are also small streets with cafes that I get lost on. but I don't go there often. I don't go to the mall/school, etc. have been to bathrooms with very long rows of tiny stalls.
